title: Integrations
dependencyMapSubtitle: Which agent depends on which service
kpiNeedsSetupHint: Waiting for credentials to be added
kpiAttentionHint: Setup exists but there is no real connection yet
notSupportedTooltip: This service is not supported in this version
noDependencies: No agent dependencies recorded for the current integrations
noEnvPath: There is no setup path for this service in this version — no environment variable and no real connection built yet.
envManagedNote: These values are managed from the server's environment variables (.env) — they cannot be added or edited from this interface, and their values are never shown here to any role.
testResultAuthFailed: Authentication failed — check that the key is correct
testDisabledTooltip: There is no real connection built for this service yet in this version
noRealConnectionNote: There is no real connection to this service in this version — any existing setup is not used by any current code.
scopeUnverifiedNote: Not verified live (no OAuth connected yet)
noScopesNote: This service has no fine-grained scope system — the current credentials grant full access when available.
noSyncLogForIntegration: No sync log for this integration yet
dependencyImpactNote: If this integration is disconnected: these agents stay Online, but the tool tied to it becomes unavailable (INTEGRATION_REQUIRED) until reconnected.
noAgentDependency: No agent currently relies on this integration.
noErrorsForIntegration: No errors recorded for this integration
checkAllNoneToTest: No real integration is currently testable

guide.aiStep1: Get an API key from your {provider} account.
guide.aiStep2: Paste it below and press "Save and test". It is encrypted and only used for your workspace.
guide.keyRejected: The provider rejected this key. Check that it was copied in full and is still valid, then try again. Nothing was saved.
